summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and implementation plan for upgrading JalRakshak 1.0 to JalRakshak 2.0 Multi-Hazard Mountain Risk Intelligence Platform. Specifies all 20 required system components (inputs, outputs, database tables, API endpoints, frontend components, ML dependencies, and module dependencies), multi-hazard synthesis equations, interactive telemetry simulator, switchable GIS layers, and a phased execution roadmap.
